notes.title: v 1.1.0 Update
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone, it's been a while. [/p][p][/p][p]I have FINALLY completed migrating from using Unity to Godot. I appreciate your guy's patience on that matter. Also wanted to go over the differences between each version.[/p][p][/p][h3]Main Interface[/h3][p]We both know it's horrendous. So I reduced the clutter and size of some elements to focus more on what's most important. The PICKLE.[/p][p]Before:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42180576/3b3c2cbae5616844999f921b74cea7c44cee17d1.png"][/img][/p][p]After: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42180576/f4c5299475dbb7f9f0d35c3e5d74f3f24518fc78.png"][/img][/p][h3]Pickle Bombs[/h3][p]You can drag and drop them wherever on the screen now and manually detonate them through double-clicking. You can also change the fuse length which can impact how much damage it can do.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/QKEhlQpQnC4"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Shop[/h3][p]Shows tips and other things in the top left, added a tip jar for fun, and changed the color scheme so that it's not so repetitive.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/3wrM57IyeBQ"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Customizing Appearance[/h3][p]Pretty similar I'd say, but you can now change the color on some accessories. Same colors as the shop[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/sYJl3kk3Gbo"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Poglins[/h3][p]New base appearance. Wanted to make them look cuter and "innocent". Also easier to work with so I can make more Poglin variants.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42180576/ae3afd629ad4a63f850735d5e6b5e0fd32008a1e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Achievements[/h3][p]I added some more achievements as well as some that were suggested from [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1919500/discussions/0/3810657811755164955/"]Achievement Suggestions[/url], but I'm not going to make them Steam achievements yet. That's just me being unsure of whenever or not this should absolutely be an achievement listed on Steam.[/p][p][/p][h3]Conclusion[/h3][p]That's pretty much sums this migration up. I'll still be developing the game, but it won't be my biggest focus in my overall activities. Also its been quite the learning experience moving this over to Godot from the ground up, and I hope this version is easier to navigate through, and most importantly fun. If you have any questions, I'll answer them as best as I can.[/p]

notes.title: Migration to Godot
notes.notes:
Thank you for everyone for your support on the recent announcement. It has been quite a while since I've said anything after, but here I am announcing that I'm going to re-create the game entirely in the Godot game engine. 

Why of this you may ask? Well as of the past week or so, Unity announced their new runtime installation fees which in summary, when passing certain parameters on your game made with Unity, their will be charges per install of the game. As of currently they are updating the runtime fee, instead of removing it entirely, which in return is still quite upsetting. 

More information can be found here in this video: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LlPOn0nAOeo]Unity's New Pricing is... Awful by Gamefromscratch[/url]

And to be honest this doesn't really affect me at all, not having met the criteria, but in the end it is quite outrageous of Unity to announce this, as it affects developers who have used Unity, either big or small out there who have made games much better than mine. So as a result I've also decided to join the movement in migrating to a more trustworthy platform much like Godot.

Don't worry, I'll keep the current version of the game up and running, whilst having the version made in Godot be available. The unfortunate part is that I won't be updating the version created with Unity anymore, but when I eventually have the Godot version up to date, it'll be replacing the current version.

As of that, I can only hope for you, the reader, to understand my decision, but if it does leave a bad impression, I'll try my best to accommodate for all the time I've spent neglecting the games development, towards a better version of the game in the near future.

notes.title: Progress on Pickle Clicker
notes.notes:
So I haven't been really touched to develop the game any further in months, I can't really say anything other than to greatly apologize for the disappointment I've created for the creation of the game. I haven't given much transparency as to where I was in development, or what I was doing with the game. Not only that, I don't really get myself involved with the community as much as I can.

I don't know what to do other than to take the game off of Steam or finally make changes in how much time I put into it and have a consistent update schedule.

As for the game itself, it of course needs a lot of work before it's considered a "decent" game. I do much appreciate the criticism in the reviews most noting that there's needs to be much more content and a system to where it adds replayability. If I ever do buckle down and get serious about a consistent schedule, I'll be adding more Poglin variants, cosmetics, the rebirth/ascension system, and quality of life. Furthermore I'll try my damndest to get involved with the community but we'll find out if that happens.

One more thing is my appreciation to all the people that played my horrendous game over the past year, albeit for achievements, or curiosity, I never really expected much to come from this. So thank you all for your participation and time appended to the game!

notes.title: Progress on v 1.0.9
notes.notes:
Just wanted to make an announcement regarding the progress of creating v 1.0.9. Unfortunately it is going to take a while, hopefully up to one more month max, [b]as I have a job and school I need to tend to[/b], so I will not have as much time to develop the game. Although the biggest thing of what I have done so far is implement pickle bombs to increase your defenses against Poglins as shown below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42180576/3b3c2cbae5616844999f921b74cea7c44cee17d1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42180576/886a89b80a8c5f2f1816153d49ea32ea7452f95b.png[/img]

Some upgrades in accordance to Pickle Bombs:
[list]
[*] More Explosions: Increases the amount of bombs you can have.
[*] Bigger Bomb: Increases the bombs damage.
[*] Stronger Scent: Increases the bombs detection radius.
[/list]
There are also some other upgrades that will be fully implemented in the game.

Not only that but I felt like that the achievements where a giant pain in the behind and I felt I was over using the use of 69 and 420 references, so I'll be replacing those with the values, 50 and 250. Also I noticed that you could not get an achievement due to insufficient amount of upgrades.

All Poglins will be decreased to two health points and Earth Poglins will have one armor point as I thought later on when you level up, you would have to resort to an auto clicker or completely destroy your mouse to kill one Poglin. 

Most importantly I'm going to remove the Playfab login system as it is completely useless at the moment and there is no point at all in having an current account. ONCE AGAIN, huge L from me and I take full responsibility for implementing it in the first place. ːsteamfacepalmː

If you have anything you think needs work, please reply to this post, and I'll figure something out.

Thank you for your time for reading this post, and I appreciate the potential feedback! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Pickle Clicker Roadmap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42180576/7490adae2dca7163f8a5828e127dc9ef048ab8a8.png[/img]Below I've quickly put together a general idea I'm going to be taking when developing the game, as shown below. I may or may not be able to do what I wanted to do for each season, but I'll try my best! 

Also if you ever want to give me suggestions live, talk and hang out with me while I code the game, check out my Twitch: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/shard_bn]https://www.twitch.tv/shard_bn[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42180576/7490adae2dca7163f8a5828e127dc9ef048ab8a8.png[/img]

More details about this are shown below:

[h3]Fall (v 1.0.8 Update) - Pickle Skins[/h3]
Summary: Bored of clicking on the tiring same pickle? Well pickle skins are finally here to enhance your pickle, and maybe your life. How do you get these? Well remember those useless pickle coins you've been collecting? Yeah, that's the currency to purchase them, believe it or not. 

[h3]Winter (v 1.0.9 Update) - Pickle Bombs & Tweaking[/h3]
Summary: Buy pickle bombs to boost your Poglin killing firepower! Attract those Poglins up with the sweet scent of zesty pickles and blow them to pieces! (Max of three pickle bombs) Oh and there's going to be complete changes to scaling of both auto pickles and upgrade pickles and other things. 

[h3]Spring (v 1.1.0 Update) - Pickle Ascension[/h3]
Summary: Ascend to new heights with pickle ascensions, unlocking even more pickle clicking power with each rebirth and become a pickle clicking god. You'll be able to unlock and receive pickle tokens to purchase these upgrades. 

[h3]Summer (v 1.1.1 Update) - Poglin Boss[/h3]
Summary: The king of all Poglins is coming to tax your pickle production! Attempt to fight and defeat the boss once every day to earn a surplus amount of pickle coins and some pickle tokens. Failure to do so with result in the destruction of your pickle picking production.

If you have any questions or ideas, feel free to share and discuss!
